themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 8 THIS WEEK compared to a 1.4-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 482% spike (z-score: 6.68)—suggesting a coordinated campaign or enforcement gap in Forest Hills/Rego Park.
evidence: 8 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (482% increase, z-score: 6.68)
Statistically significant anomaly with high severity classification
No prior media coverage or Reddit discussion, suggesting emerging rather than chronic issue
reporting_angles: Ground canvass: photograph and map specific locations of illegal postings to identify patterns (political, commercial, gang-related)
Interview Sanitation Department about enforcement deployment and whether complaints correlate with specific neighborhoods within CD406

themes_detail.label: Panhandling Crisis Acceleration
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints jumped to 7 LAST WEEK from a 0.6-complaint weekly average—a 1020% spike (z-score: 9.16, highest severity)—indicating a sharp deterioration in street conditions and possible homeless services failure.
evidence: 7 panhandling complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1020% increase, z-score: 9.16—highest z-score in dataset)
Community Board budget requests repeatedly cite need for 'expand street outreach' and Fair Fares funding, suggesting chronic homeless/poverty issues now accelerating
Department of Homeless Services street outreach expansion flagged as unfunded priority in CB budget
reporting_angles: Interview homeless outreach workers and DHS about whether resources are inadequate for current street population in Forest Hills
Track specific subway stations, commercial corridors, and residential blocks where panhandling concentrated; interview residents and business owners about changes in past 2 weeks
Analyze whether uptick correlates with shelter capacity constraints or loss of temporary services

themes_detail.label: Plumbing & Appliance Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Plumbing complaints hit 3 THIS WEEK (vs. 0.6 weekly average, 380% spike, z-score: 3.41) and appliance complaints peaked at 9 THREE WEEKS AGO (vs. 1.9 weekly average, 380% spike)—suggesting systemic building infrastructure failures alongside broader heat/hot water crisis (904 complaints over 90 days).
evidence: 3 plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% increase, z-score: 3.41)
9 appliance complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 1.9 weekly average (380% increase, z-score: 3.75)
Heat/hot water remains top complaint category overall (904 complaints last 90 days), indicating sustained infrastructure crisis affecting habitability
296 DOB building permits filed (241 alterations), suggesting active renovation work that may disrupt systems or exacerbate failures
reporting_angles: Survey affected tenants and landlords: are failures clustered in specific buildings or blocks? Are there common causes (age of building stock, water main issues, boiler failures)?
Investigate whether recent utility work or DOB permits correlate with spike in plumbing/appliance failures
Interview HPD and DOB about enforcement actions for habitability violations in Forest Hills—are landlords penalized for repeated heat/hot water/plumbing violations?

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Vegetation & Tree Safety
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree/branch complaints spiked to 8 TWO WEEKS AGO from a 2.4-complaint weekly average (237% increase, z-score: 4.27), suggesting Parks Department maintenance lag and potential hazards to pedestrians and property.
evidence: 8 overgrown tree/branch complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 2.4 weekly average (237% increase, z-score: 4.27)
Community Board budget repeatedly requests 'provide new or expanded park or amenity' and Parks infrastructure investment, indicating chronic underfunding
Street condition complaints remain high (976 over 90 days), suggesting broader maintenance crisis of which overgrown vegetation may be symptom
reporting_angles: Canvass neighborhoods to document unsafe trees/branches and photograph hazards; identify if issues concentrated in specific parks or streets
Request Parks Department maintenance schedules and backlog data—how long do tree complaints take to resolve in Forest Hills vs. other CDs?
Interview residents about whether tree neglect poses safety risks (falling branches, blocked sidewalks, vision obstruction)

themes_detail.label: Rodent & Pigeon Infestation Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary animal/pigeon complaints spiked THREE WEEKS AGO (3 animal complaints last week, 700% increase; 3 pigeon complaints, 380% increase)—indicating emerging pest control failure amid ongoing sanitation strain.
evidence: 3 unsanitary animal private property complaints last week vs. 0.4 weekly average (700% increase, z-score: 3.77)
3 unsanitary pigeon condition complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.6 weekly average (380% increase, z-score: 3.41)
No recent Reddit or media coverage, suggesting emerging issue not yet on public radar
reporting_angles: Ground reconnaissance: identify blocks with visible rodent/pigeon activity and correlate with 311 complaint locations
Interview Sanitation Department about pest control protocols and whether resources are deployed to Forest Hills
Survey residents about whether they perceive increased rodent/pigeon problems; document health/quality-of-life impact
